Theoretical pI is 11.321 and estimated charge at pH 7 is +11.742, indicating a strongly basic protein.
Pfam detects ATP-synt_D (PF01813.23) at positions 11–202 with i-Evalue 1.1e-41.
The sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein A7HDG7 from Anaeromyxobacter sp. Fw109-5.

entities.name: V-type ATP synthase subunit D
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate this protein as V-type ATP synthase subunit D.
Subunit D is part of the proton-transporting ATP synthase rotary complex and is associated with proton-motive-force-driven ATP synthesis.

The exact-sequence reference assigns ATP-binding and proton-transporting ATP synthase activity terms, but these are complex-level annotations and do not prove that isolated subunit D independently catalyzes ATP synthesis.
